content:
Mire Magic Moonshine is a green-colored spirit made from acidic gulper venom, bottled in a repurposed Nukashine jug. It was once produced by Slayer's gang at the Sunday Brothers' cabin with the help of Moonshiner Ned. After the gang's deaths, Ned still hopes to produce more during a Moonshine Jamboree.[1] The item increases damage dealt when using a gulper Smacker by +50% when using the fresh variant, and +100% when using the vintage variant.

PCXbox OnePlaystation 4 While there is a recipe for crafting fermentable Mire Magic Moonshine,[2] the recipe lacks a keyword to associate it to any workbench, making it uncraftable.[verified]
